learning_objective: 🎯 Step into the future! Discover how computers, software, and digital tools are expanding the boundaries of traditional art making.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Digital art is any artwork created using digital technology as an essential part of the creative process. It uses screens instead of canvas, and software tools instead of physical paint.

Raster images (like photos) are made of thousands of tiny colored squares called 'pixels'; they get blurry if you zoom in too much. Vector graphics use mathematical lines and curves; they stay perfectly smooth no matter how big you make them.

Artists use specialized software to create digital art. Programs like Adobe Photoshop (for raster editing/painting), Adobe Illustrator (for vector logos), and free tools like MS Paint or Canva are standard.

Instead of drawing with a clumsy computer mouse, digital artists use a graphics tablet and a 'stylus' (a pen-like tool). It senses how hard the artist presses (pressure sensitivity) to make lines thicker or darker.
One of the greatest advantages of digital art is non-destructive editing. You can use 'Layers' to separate parts of your drawing, and easily 'Undo' mistakes without ruining the paper.

fun_activity.title: 👾 Pixel Art Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Open MS Paint (or a grid paper if you don't have a computer). Zoom in really close and draw a character (like Mario or an emoji) by coloring in one small square (pixel) at a time. Zoom out to see the final image!

exam_tips: 📌 Clearly differentiate between Raster (pixel-based, gets blurry) and Vector (math-based, infinite scaling).
📌 Mention digital art tools: Graphics tablet, stylus, and software (Photoshop/CorelDraw).
📌 Highlight the advantages of digital art: easy corrections (undo), layers, and no physical mess to clean up.
quick_recap: ⭐ The resolution of a digital image is determined by the number of pixels it has (higher pixels = better quality).
⭐ Layers allow artists to paint the background and foreground separately without them mixing.
⭐ Digital art is widely used in making animations, video games, movie posters, and web design.
